rationale: The workflow repeatedly downloads dependencies with dnf on every run (git, then fedora-packager/python3-specfile) with no dependency cache. Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Cache dependency downloads) is evidence-supported: it targets repeated dependency fetching, keeps all installation and required tests, and reports a modest aggregate VM-time reduction. Adding an actions/cache@v4 step for /var/cache/dnf after checkout and before the build-dependency install reuses downloaded packages across runs. The cache key is keyed on the workflow file (which lists the packages) so dependency changes invalidate the cache, satisfying the lockfile/environment precondition as closely as possible for a dnf-based workflow. No build or test steps are removed, permissions are unchanged, and no new secrets, deployment operations, or privileged actions are introduced.
